title: A Machine Learning Approach to Classifying EEG Data Collected with or without Haptic Feedback during a Simulated Drilling Task
summary: Feature selection over EEG time/frequency/nonlinear features supports ML classification with versus without haptic feedback. Results reports >90% accuracy with five features and 99% with ten; task-specific simulated drilling EEG. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: Ontario Tech University; University Colombian School of Engineering Julio Garavito; Universidad del Rosario
